programs.showName: Lion: The Rise and Fall of the Marsh Pride
programs.description: The pride of swamp lions in Kenya was filmed for over three decades, telling the epic story of the group's life: alliances, births, betrayals, and wars for the throne. Today, habitat loss and population growth have pushed the Masai Mara lions to the brink of extinction. The swamp pride is still fighting for its survival. While Kenya strives to preserve this natural heritage, threats remain for the future of these apex predators.
